name: Jack & Diane — Coupang Ending v1
description: 시리즈 공통 3컷 제품 엔딩입니다. 구조(3컷)와 캐릭터 구도는 고정이고, 제품·시연 동작·제품별 대사만 바뀝니다.

shopping_excuse.story_en: Diane realises the situation gives her a reason to shop on Coupang. She is genuinely thrilled — she is almost happier about having a shopping excuse than about solving the problem.
shopping_excuse.visual: Diane with her phone, Coupang app glowing on the screen, eyes sparkling, a huge delighted grin; the original problem is clearly visible behind her but she barely cares.
shopping_excuse.action: Diane gasps, grabs her phone and starts scrolling with obvious joy.

lines.speaker: diane
lines.en: BABYYYY!!! Perfect excuse to order {{PRODUCT_NAME}} on Coupang!
lines.ko: 자기야!!! {{PRODUCT_NAME_KO}} 쿠팡에서 살 완벽한 핑계가 생겼어!

product_demonstration.story_en: The actual approved product is installed and used, clearly and concisely. Preserve the product's real appearance and function; no invented features or claims.
product_demonstration.visual: Close, clear view of the approved product being used. {{DEMO_ACTION}} Keep the product's shape, colour and logo exactly like the approved reference images.

jack_reaction.story_en: Diane proudly shows Jack the product. Jack lovingly praises her but refuses to change his own behaviour or use the product. This is the recurring series-ending gag.
jack_reaction.visual: Diane proudly presenting the product to Jack; Jack affectionate but immovable, arms crossed, dry smile; Diane's indignation at the end.
jack_reaction.action: Diane shows off the product; Jack praises her, then flatly refuses; Diane yells his name.
